{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies error handling in src/rpc/util.cpp and updates tests for rpc_getdescriptorinfo and rpc_scantxoutset to avoid leaking keys in RPC responses.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents RPC error responses from exposing raw private keys and xprvs into application logs, error reporters, or shared screenshots. The RPC guidelines prioritize interface security and preventing the exposure of sensitive data."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches only two lines in src/util/bip32.cpp in service of descriptor error formatting.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change to BIP32 utility code is an incidental helper edit following from the descriptor and wallet error-handling changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes descriptor parsing in src/script/descriptor.cpp, import handling in src/wallet/imports.cpp, and spend logic in src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "fund safety",
      "rationale": "Stops raw private keys (WIF, xprv) from being echoed in descriptor parsing and wallet import/funding failure messages. Leaking secret key material into logs and error reports directly compromises key privacy and fund safety."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
